paper_metadata.title: Enhanced strength and ductility in a high-entropy alloy via ordered oxygen complexes

evidence.quote: We studied the base alloy TiZrHfNb, the optimally oxygen-doped variant (TiZrHfNb)98O2 (hereafter denoted as O-2 HEA) and for comparison also an interstitial variant with 2.0 at% nitrogen (at%, atomic per cent), that is, (TiZrHfNb)98N2, hereafter referred to as N-2 HEA.

Here, alloy ingots with a nominal composition of TiZrHfNb, (TiZrHfNb)98O2 and (TiZrHfNb)98N2 (at%) were prepared by arc-melting a mixture of pure metals (purity > 99.9 wt%), TiN (99.9 wt%) and TiO2 (99.9 wt%) in a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere.
